FALSE POSITIVE (code-scanning triage 2026-10-24, alert hypatia/green_web/non_green_hosting): the rule substring-matches its non-green provider list against ALL workflow text and always reports file '.github/workflows/' with no line, so the finding names neither the file nor the token that matched. The only match in this tree is the Cloudflare R2 backup job in mirror-reusable.yml: it runs the preinstalled AWS CLI ('aws s3 cp') against a *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com endpoint with AWS_* credential variables. Nothing this repository publishes is hosted on any provider in the rule's non-green list. The correct fix is upstream in hypatia (word-boundary matching plus a real file:line), tracked separately; this ack is keyed on the rule's fixed pseudo-path, so if a workflow ever genuinely targets a non-green provider this entry must be removed and the rule fixed instead.
